1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP comprises a machine-readable identifier that is not merely affixed to an external surface of the test tube but is structurally integrated into the test tube material itself.

2. (Previously presented) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube configured for long-term storage of biological samples at cryogenic temperatures.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer, and wherein the embedding is achieved through a thermal integration process that melts a portion of the polymer material.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

(Currently Amended) A system for storing samples and comprising of the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack specifically designed for biorepository test tubes; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes with integrated MTP reading capability; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes while maintaining MTP readability.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, wherein the racks and test tubes are stored and handled at -20°C or less, and wherein the MTP remains readable at such temperatures.

15. (Previously presented) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising embedding a MTP in plastic or comprising heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP.

16. (Previously presented) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded MTP; and reading the MTP.

17. (Previously presented) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer, and wherein the embedding is achieved through a thermal integration process.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.
